html:
We Help You Navigate Uncertain Times with Empathy and Experience

Specialist Family and Divorce Lawyers Serving Sydney

The process of getting divorced or separating from a partner can often leave you feeling anxious and overwhelmed.

We want to help by offering you a consultation where we will answer any questions about your specific situation and provide you with a detailed plan that will leave you clear on what to expect, the next steps and an estimate of costs.

You can find out more details about the consultation below or simply contact us by clicking on the button, and our client services manager will contact you within 3 business hours to arrange a time for us to meet.

Tash Nolan - Director

Nolan Family Lawyers

What to Expect from Your Consultation

You’re probably feeling overwhelmed and unsure where to begin, so we want to help. Navigating a family law matter can be challenging, but you don’t have to do it alone. Our dedicated team is here to listen, understand your unique situation, and provide clear guidance on your options.

After completing a consultation, you will walk away with:

You’ll walk away with answers to all of your questions and the confidence and knowledge that you are ready to tackle what can be a very difficult time.

Arrange your consultation today using the button below.

Comprehensive family law services

Our team of specialist family lawyers have years of experience in divorce, parenting arrangements, property settlements, de facto relationships, child support and spousal maintenance. Feel confident knowing we’re the best family lawyers serving Sydney:

Family Law Advice Book Your Consultation

Typical response within 3 business hours.

Meet Our Specialist Family Law Team

Our team of specialist family lawyers understand that the only winners in long, drawn out court battles are lawyers.

Instead, we strive on your behalf to find mutually acceptable agreements with both parties before matters proceed to the courts. This can help you achieve a reasonable outcome in a professional and effective manner. The idea of a “bulldog lawyer fighting for you” is outdated. An aggressive, combative approach can result in a lengthy expensive processes that is damaging for all parties involved and costs you more than is needed.

Instead we focus on being open and communicative to create an amicable and equitable outcome for you and your dependants – while remaining highly capable in confidently championing your rights. Enquire today and experience our difference.
